library_preparation_preflight.agent_guidance: To get meaningful coverage beyond a trivial text round-trip, prefer a test that exercises streambuffer's distinguishing feature: creating a MutableXMLStreamBuffer from an XMLStreamReader that implements org.jvnet.staxex.XMLStreamReaderEx (or similar binary-preserving path) and asserting the buffered content round-trips through a jakarta.activation.DataHandler/Base64Data without re-encoding. If the test only reads/writes plain XML via StAX/SAX/DOM, the extra dependency may be unused and can be dropped.
risks: Network access and filesystem access outside this worktree were unavailable in this session, so streambuffer's POM/dependency graph could not be fetched directly from Maven Central; this conclusion is based on architectural knowledge of the Metro codebase plus concrete precedent from two sibling libraries in the same release family already in this repo.

If generated tests end up exercising only the plain StAX/SAX/DOM buffering path (no binary/attachment handling), the extra dependency is harmless but unnecessary — local Gradle/Native Image verification should confirm actual need.
